mandates.title: Mandates ledger
mandates.lead: The mandates this workspace has granted, with what each has settled, what calls in flight hold, and what is left. A mandate is the only thing that lets an agent carry a consequence, and every draw on it reserves, then settles or releases.
mandates.empty: No mandate has been granted in this workspace.
mandates.emptyDetail: A call that carries a consequence tag with no mandate is denied before dispatch, whether or not the tool is on the agent's belt.
mandates.truncated: The newest {shown} mandates. This workspace has granted at least that many, and older ones are not listed here.
mandates.partial: You see the mandates of the agents you created. This ledger is not every mandate this workspace has granted.
mandates.emptyListed: No mandate is listed here. The ledger above is not complete, so that is not a statement that the workspace has granted none.
mandates.emptyListedDetail: An org Owner, Admin, Billing or Compliance reader sees every mandate this workspace has granted. This ledger is written for that office.
